name: Airbnb

Software Engineer (entry–mid).dsaDepth: Heavy — 2 back-to-back LeetCode medium–hard coding rounds, little to no system design at this level
rounds: Online coding assessment (CodeSignal) for some pipelines
Two 45-minute technical coding interviews (CoderPad/Zoom): data structures, algorithms, edge cases, complexity — no heavy system design at junior/mid level
Cross-team "values" interview (~45 min): collaboration, ownership, communication, product sense
extraTopics: Airbnb’s well-known "11 Core Values" culture round
Correctness and edge-case handling under time pressure

Senior Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Heavy — coding remains, system design and pull-request review are added
rounds: Onsite/virtual loop (~5 rounds): coding, system design (e.g. designing a booking system), a technical-experience deep dive, core-values interview, and a pull-request-review exercise
extraTopics: System design at Airbnb’s marketplace scale (search, booking, trust & safety)
Reviewing a colleague’s pull request — a distinctive round format

Staff Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate — architecture, scope and technical leadership dominate
rounds: Deeper system-design and architecture rounds, technical strategy discussion, staff-level values interview
Staff Software Engineer.notes: Thinner public detail at this level.
